PRJ-03 Web application

Farm Supply Inventory Management System

A system that helps farm supply businesses manage inventory records, organize product information, monitor stock levels, and maintain accurate inventory data.

Staff dashboard (sample data)

Links

GitHub repository

The problem

Farm supply businesses carry many different products and need to know what is in stock. This system keeps inventory records and product information organized so stock levels can be monitored and the data stays accurate.

The solution

A system that stores inventory records, organizes product information, lets the business monitor stock levels, and keeps inventory data accurate.

Implemented features

  • Inventory management
  • Product tracking
  • Stock level monitoring
  • Accurate inventory data
  • CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)

Technologies used

  • PHP
  • Laravel
  • Blade
  • MySQL
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Alpine.js
  • Vite
